title: Bonampak Murals
summary: Wall and ceiling paintings in the three rooms of the Temple of the Paintings at Bonampak, Chiapas, Mexico, dated to about 790 CE in the Late Classic period. INAH describes processions and musicians, a battle with the sacrifice of captives, and a festive ceremony with dancers and bloodletting, made in the reign of Chan Muwan II.

uncertainty.note: Encyclopedia.com: around 790 CE (latest Long Count 9.18.0.0.0); INAH: 8th century, reign of Chan Muwan II, in power from 776. Range runs from his accession to c. 790.
